name: Calendly
whatYouLose: Deep enterprise calendar administration and round-robin routing
Native integrations with every CRM and video meeting provider
Battle-tested timezone and edge-case handling at global scale
prompt: Build a self-hosted one-person scheduling app. The owner configures weekly availability, meeting lengths, buffers, minimum notice, and blackout dates. Visitors see available slots in their timezone, enter name/email/notes, and receive an .ics invitation. Prevent double booking with SQLite transactions. Include a private admin page protected by an environment password, reschedule and cancel links with signed tokens, accessible date and time pickers, email templates, tests for timezone boundaries, and a deployment README. Use Astro server output and vanilla JavaScript only.
notes: For a solo operator with a small menu of meeting types, this is exactly the kind of narrow SaaS replacement that vibecoding handles well.
